messages:
maya (Marketing): Draft is in the doc — quick triage please. Need a hero decision, benchmark callout copy, webinar CTA, and inbound lead routing. Target publish Wed EOD, copy freeze today.
sam (Product): On it. Quick Q: the benchmark claim currently says ‘2x faster’ — should we keep that or switch to p50/p95 callouts?
leo (Growth): Recommend p95 and a short note on tail latency. Also suggest 2 CTAs: one for benchmark deep-dive, one for product demo (segmented flows).
nina (Design): Re: hero — I think a console + compact latency sparkline works better than the current hero art. Will post a mock in the doc in 30m.
maya (Marketing): Sweet. Can we lock hero by EOD? Also need webinar registration flow mapped to HubSpot lists. @ken can you confirm inbound mapping/connectors?
ken (Growth Ops): Yep. Plan: two HubSpot lists: "Launch - Interest" and "Launch - Benchmarks"; utm_campaign=redwood-launch-q2. Leads with score >50 go to SDR queue; others to nurture. I’ll add the form embed snippet.
sam (Product): For precision, how about: "50% lower median latency; 30% lower p95 vs baseline" and add a footnote: test workload = synth traces v1.1. I can write the appendix.
maya (Marketing): That reads safer. Sam, can you drop the appendix in the doc? Also, let's avoid absolute model names in hero copy — keep it performance vs baseline.
leo (Growth): I'll draft CTA variants: 1) "See the benchmark" (for eng buyers) and 2) "Book a demo" (for GTM/enterprise). Also propose a small gated benchmark kit for webinar registrants.
nina (Design): Mock uploaded: /files/hero-console-sparkline.png. Two small asks: (1) shorter headline, (2) a hero subline that calls out "real-world p95" instead of generic "faster".
maya (Marketing): Great mock. Who can sign off on final hero + CTA? @nina @leo please.
nina (Design): :thumbsup: I can sign off on visuals once copy is locked.
leo (Growth): I’ll approve CTAs after Ken confirms HubSpot routing and sample confirmation emails.
publish-bot: deploy scheduled: staging preview publish at 2026-03-24T10:00:00Z for thread 5987654321
maya (Marketing): Timeline recap: copy freeze 17:00 PT today, design freeze 18:00 PT, publish-preview 10:00 UTC tomorrow, final approvals by 21:00 PT tonight. If any blockers call them out now.
ken (Growth Ops): Ack timeline. Webinar slot penciled Thurs 09:00 PT. I’ll wire the HubSpot form -> campaign and set lead source parameter.
sam (Product): One last editorial note: add a short paragraph comparing latency/cost vs a common open baseline — helps enterprise POV.
maya (Marketing): Added that paragraph and updated CTAs in the doc. Thank you all — I'll ping when the doc is updated. :rocket:
